trust_decision.summary: Which Java classes may be instantiated when KAPT reads its on-disk incremental cache files (java-cache.bin, apt-cache.bin); before the fix any class on the classpath was accepted by a plain ObjectInputStream in JavaClassCacheManager.

landing_point.why: The advisory names the Kotlin build cache and Java deserialization; grepping KAPT for ObjectInputStream lands on JavaClassCacheManager's two cache readers, which share a TODO about switching away from Java serialization (cache.kt:10).

fix_sites.entry_point: kapt compiler plugin option INCREMENTAL_CACHE (plugins/kapt/kapt-compiler/src/org/jetbrains/kotlin/kapt/KaptPlugin.kt:81) -> KaptContext init -> JavaClassCacheManager.maybeGetAptCacheFromFile (apt-cache.bin)
same option -> JavaClassCacheManager.maybeGetJavaCacheFromFile (java-cache.bin), nested readObject in JavaClassCache.readObject (classStructureCache.kt:44-46)
KaptContext constructor (public open class), passes logger to the cache manager; plumbing only

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Both published sites sit in one file (cache.kt) of one module; KaptContext.kt change is plumbing only. The out-of-scope-looking surfaces are unfixed routes, recorded in O8.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The KGP classpath-snapshot readers live in the Gradle plugin, not in the KAPT compiler plugin the report points at; their files are written by Gradle-managed transforms and task local state, so a solver can argue they are 'Gradle-owned' or not the 'KAPT incremental cache'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Incremental KAPT must still reload legitimate caches: JavaClassCache holds ClassFileStructure entries whose declaredTypes is a Collections$SingletonSet and java.net.URI keys, IncrementalAptCache holds java.io.File; an allowlist missing any of these silently degrades every build to a full rebuild (fix added testJavaCacheCanDeserializeClassFileStructure for this).

O6_input_shapes: top-level object of a non-allowlisted class in java-cache.bin
top-level object of a non-allowlisted class in apt-cache.bin
non-allowlisted class nested inside an allowed container (via JavaClassCache.readObject's inner readObject)
array types of non-allowlisted component classes (multi-dimensional '[[L...;' unwrapped)
allowlisted but wrong top-level type (instance check, delete file)

O7_producer.where: plugins/kapt/kapt-base/src/org/jetbrains/kotlin/kapt/base/incremental/cache.kt:169-189 (close() writes both files); for O8: libraries/tools/kotlin-gradle-plugin/src/common/kotlin/org/jetbrains/kotlin/gradle/internal/kapt/incremental/ClasspathAnalyzer.kt:60-69 (cacheable artifact transform writes output.bin)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: KGP KaptTask loads the previous classpath snapshot (classpath-entries.bin, ap-classpath-entries.bin, classpath-structure.bin) from the same incAptCache dir with a plain ObjectInputStream.readObject.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Lives in the Gradle plugin, not KAPT; files are Gradle task local state that 'only the build writes'.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different module (libraries/tools/kotlin-gradle-plugin vs plugins/kapt/kapt-base), different package (org.jetbrains.kotlin.gradle.internal.kapt.incremental); reached from KaptTask.kt:226

O8_uncovered_routes.route: KGP ClasspathEntryData.ClasspathEntrySerializer.loadFrom reads per-artifact structure files (output.bin of the @CacheableTransform StructureTransformAction, which can be served from a Gradle build cache) with a plain ObjectInputStream.readObject.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is an artifact-transform output managed by Gradle, and ClasspathEntryData has a custom readObject reading only ints/UTF, so it looks already safe; the top-level class descriptor is still resolved unfiltered.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different module and package from landing point; called from ClasspathSnapshot.kt:132

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the .kapt_metadata reader could realistically read its line-info map with readObject() instead of readInt/readUTF
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: it already opens an ObjectInputStream on a build-output file next to stubs; switching to writeObject/readObject of a Map is a natural simplification a maintainer could make

O8b_injection_room.sibling: decodeMap of base64 apoptions/javacArguments could read a whole Map via readObject
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: already an ObjectInputStream over externally supplied bytes; the encoder side would only need writeObject(map)

O9_family: CWE-502 unsafe Java deserialization of build cache / incremental state files

O10_build.toolchain: Gradle (repo wrapper) with JDK; the kotlin monorepo bootstraps a released Kotlin compiler
O10_build.project_tests: plugins/kapt/kapt-base/test/org/jetbrains/kotlin/kapt/base/test/incremental/JavaClassCacheManagerTest.kt and sibling incremental tests; libraries/tools/kotlin-gradle-plugin/src/test/kotlin/org/jetbrains/kotlin/gradle/internal/kapt/incremental/ClasspathSnapshotTest.kt and ClasspathAnalyzerTest.kt for the O8 routes

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a resolveClass allowlist to the two JavaClassCacheManager readers only (or only the java-cache reader reproduced), omitting Collections$SingletonSet/URI/File or arrays and leaving the KGP classpath-snapshot readers open.

out_of_scope_notes: Other unfiltered readObject on files exist outside KAPT: libraries/tools/kotlin-gradle-plugin/src/common/kotlin/org/jetbrains/kotlin/gradle/testing/internal/TestReportService.kt:91-93, libraries/tools/kotlin-gradle-plugin/src/common/kotlin/org/jetbrains/kotlin/compilerRunner/btapi/BtaCompilerRunner.kt:80, libraries/scripting/jvm/src/kotlin/script/experimental/jvm/impl/KJvmCompiledScript.kt:196 (different features; not pursued).
